Name: Baasha, King of Israel
Summary: Baasha of Issachar conspired against Nadab, wiped out Jeroboam's house as prophesied, yet walked in Jeroboam's sins himself and warred with Asa of Judah.
KeyStory: Baasha wipes out Jeroboam's house and repeats his sin.
RelatedPeople: Nadab, King of Israel; Elah, King of Israel; King Asa; Jehu, Son of Hanani; Ben-hadad, King of Syria
LifeLesson: God may use a man to judge another's sin and still judge that man for his own.
